correctness.rationale: The logistic centered chord supremum is tanh(|a-b|/4) and the zero-sum row-difference Dobrushin inequality is |(Wx)i-(Wx)j|<=delta(W)D. Their Dini combination yields D^+D<=-D+tanh(beta delta D/4). Scalar comparison proves exponential decay below one and tD^2 limsup<=3/2 at one. The asymptotically autonomous scalar mean p obeys p_prime= -p+ell(theta+beta p)+o(1); the real analytic scalar field has finitely many zeros and the sign-of-crossings argument forces convergence to one zero, with all coordinates coalescing. For W_delta and theta=-beta/2, x1+x2=1 is invariant, contrast v satisfies v_prime=-v+tanh(kv); its cubic critical coefficient -1/3 attains 3/2. Nonzero roots exist iff k>1; Jacobian eigenvalues mean=-1+beta(1-v^2)/4 and contrast=-1+beta delta(1-v^2)/4. H(v)=(1-v^2)atanh(v)/v decreases strictly from 1 to 0, giving unique secondary hyperbolic sink threshold beta_s=4/(1-v_s^2), H(v_s)=delta. No nonlinear stability claim at zero eigenvalue; no claim all W above boundary support heterogeneity.
residual_risks: Finite diagnostic checks corroborate but do not replace analytical all-parameter proof.
